title: Sanitation and reclamation expert.
bodyText: The Secretary of the Interior shall designate from his Department someone experienced in sanitation, rehabilitation, and reclamation work to reside in the State and cooperate with the department in carrying out its duties. The salary of such official so designated by the Secretary of the Interior shall be paid by the department while he is carrying on his duties in the State.
bodyHtml: §224.  Sanitation and reclamation expert.  The Secretary of the Interior shall designate from his Department someone experienced in sanitation, rehabilitation, and reclamation work to reside in the State and cooperate with the department in carrying out its duties.  The salary of such official so designated by the Secretary of the Interior shall be paid by the department while he is carrying on his duties in the State. [Add Jul. 26, 1935, c 420, §2, 49 Stat 505; am imp L 1963, c 207, §5(a); am L 1976, c 120, §1]
